fallbacks.en: I do not have a reliable offline answer for that yet. Try asking about business, saving, farming, health, digital safety, jobs, or wellbeing. If this is an emergency, contact local emergency services or a trusted professional now.
fallbacks.lg: Sinnaba na kyakuddamu kya kwesigika nga tolina yintaneeti. Buuza ku busubuzi, okutereka ensimbi, obulimi, obulamu, obukuumi ku yintaneeti, emirimu oba emirembe gy'omutima. Bwe kiba kya mangu, tuukirira ab'obuyambi oba omukugu gwe weesiga.
fallbacks.sw: Sina jibu la kuaminika nje ya mtandao kwa swali hilo bado. Uliza kuhusu biashara, akiba, kilimo, afya, usalama mtandaoni, kazi au ustawi. Ikiwa ni dharura, wasiliana na huduma za dharura au mtaalamu unayemwamini sasa.
fallbacks.nyn: Tinkaine ky'okugarukamu eky'okwesiga otari aha mutimbagano hati. Buuza aha by'obushuubuzi, okutereka esente, obuhingi, amagara, oburinzi aha mutimbagano, emirimo nari embeera y'omutima. Kyaba kiri eky'amangu, shaba obuyambi aha bakugu abu orikwesiga.
fallbacks.nyo: Tinyina eky'okugarukamu eky'okwesigwa hatali ha mutimbagano hati. Kaguza ha busuubuzi, kutereka sente, bulimi, bwomeezi, obulinzi ha mutimbagano, mirimo rundi obusinge bw'omutima. Obukiraaba kiri ky'amangu, ragira ab'obuyambi rundi omukugu ow'orukwesiga.
fallbacks.ach: Pe an atye ki lagam me ada ma pe mito intanet pi lapeny man. Peny ikom cato wil, gwoko lim, pur, yotkom, ber bedo i intanet, tic onyo kuc me cwiny. Ka obedo peko me oyot, lwong jo me kony onyo ladit ma igeno.
fallbacks.teo: Mam ijai eong aijen na ejok na mam erai ka internet kotoma aswam na. Ingisit akiro nu aduka, akoru esirigin, akoru, ajar, aijar ejok toma internet, aswam arai ayalama. Karai erai na apedor, ingarakina ijo lukaingaren arai ekapolon lo ijenara.

responses.en: Start with a problem people nearby will pay to solve. Speak to at least five possible customers, estimate your costs and selling price, then test with a small quantity before borrowing or investing heavily. Keep business money separate from household money and write down every sale and expense.
responses.lg: Tandika n'ekizibu abantu abakuli okumpi kye baagala okusasulira. Yogera n'abaguzi abayinza okubaawo waakiri bataano, bala ensaasaanya n'omuwendo gw'okutunda, oluvannyuma ogezeeko n'ebintu bitono nga tonnawola oba kuteekamu nsimbi nnyingi. Yawula ensimbi z'obusubuzi ku z'awaka era wandiika buli ky'otunze n'ekisaasaanyiziddwa.
responses.sw: Anza na tatizo ambalo watu wa karibu wako tayari kulipia. Zungumza na angalau wateja watano wanaowezekana, kadiria gharama na bei, kisha jaribu kwa kiasi kidogo kabla ya kukopa au kuwekeza sana. Tenganisha pesa za biashara na za nyumbani na uandike kila mauzo na matumizi.
responses.nyn: Tandika n'ekizibu eki abantu abari haihi baakusasurira. Gamba n'abaguzi abarikubaasa kubaho nibura bataano, bara omuhendo gw'okukora n'ogw'okuguza, reero gezaaho n'ebintu bikye otakakopire nari kutaamu esente nyingi. Taanisa esente z'obushuubuzi n'ez'eka kandi handika buri ky'oguza n'eki orikushashura.
responses.nyo: Tandika n'ekizibu abantu abakuli haihi eki barukugonza kusasurra. Baza n'abaguzi abarukusobora kubaho nibura bataano, bara ensaasaanya n'omuhendo gw'okutunda, hanyuma lengeka n'ebintu bike otakakope rundi kutamu sente nyingi. Yawula sente z'obusuubuzi hali ez'eka kandi handika buli ky'otunda n'eky'osasura.
responses.ach: Cak ki peko ma dano macok kodi mito culo pire. Lok ki jo ma romo wilo romo abic, kwan wel me yub ki wel me cato, ka item ki jami manok mapwod pe ikwano lim onyo keto lim madwong. Pok lim me cato wil ki lim me gang, ki icoyo jami ducu ma icato ki ma iwilo.
responses.teo: Cakau ka apedor na itunga lukaipie ikotos asulakin. Aingit itunga luka alosit luka aduka iboro ikany, ipima isirigin luka aswam ka omusolo, epol egeutu ka iboro lu idis sek mam ipedo akop arai aidok isirigin luipu. Kanyutu isirigin luka aduka ka luka akai, ido icamuni ngesi kere lu imus.

responses.en: Use one notebook with a page for sales and another for expenses. Record the date, item, quantity and amount immediately. At the end of each week, add sales and subtract stock costs and other expenses. The remainder is profit, not the total cash received.
responses.lg: Kozesa akatabo kamu: olupapula lw'ebitundiddwa n'olulala olw'ensaasaanya. Wandiika amangu olunaku, ekintu, obungi n'omuwendo. Buli wiiki bw'eggwaako, gatta ebyatundiddwa oggyeko omuwendo gw'ebintu n'ensaasaanya endala. Esigadde ge magoba, so si ssente zonna ze wafunye.
responses.sw: Tumia daftari moja lenye ukurasa wa mauzo na mwingine wa matumizi. Andika mara moja tarehe, bidhaa, kiasi na fedha. Mwisho wa kila wiki, jumlisha mauzo kisha toa gharama ya bidhaa na matumizi mengine. Kinachobaki ndiyo faida, si fedha zote ulizopokea.
responses.nyn: Koresa akatabo kamwe, orupapura rw'eby'oguza n'orundi rw'ensaasaanya. Handika ahonaaho eizooba, ekintu, obwingi n'omuhendo. Buri saabiiti yaheza, gaita eby'oguza okihweho omuhendo gw'ebintu n'ensaasaanya ezindi. Ekisigaraho niyo magoba, ti sente zoona ezi waakiire.
responses.nyo: Kozesa akatabo kamu, orupapura rw'eby'otunda n'orundi rw'ensaasaanya. Handika aho n'aho ekiro, ekintu, obwingi n'omuhendo. Buli wiiki obw'erahwa, gaita eby'otundire oihyemu omuhendo gw'ebintu n'ensaasaanya ezindi. Ekisigalire nigo magoba, hatali sente zoona ezi watungire.
responses.ach: Tii ki buk acel: pot karatac acel pi jami ma icato ki mukene pi jami ma iwilo. Co nino, jami, wel gi ki lim oyot. I agiki me cabit, med lim me jami ma icato ka ikwany wel me jami ki jami mukene ma iwilo. Lim ma odong en aye magoba, pe lim ducu ma inongo.
responses.teo: Kojau ibuku yen ka akaratac na amusan ka ace na agwelan. Camun epone, ekakas, adio ka isirigin kapakio. Ka awasia na wiki, iboro kere lu imus ido ikunyak isirigin luka iboro ka agwelan ace. Lu ideleikin kes agogong, mam isirigin kere lu ijoikin.

en: how can I make a budget

responses.en: For one month, write down all income and spending. First cover food, housing, health, transport and debt payments. Choose a small realistic saving amount and move it aside whenever income arrives. Keep emergency savings somewhere safe but accessible, and use it only for unexpected essential costs.
responses.lg: Okumala omwezi gumu, wandiika ensimbi zonna eziyingira n'ezifuluma. Sooka osasule emmere, aw'okubeera, obulamu, entambula n'amabanja. Londa omuwendo omutono gw'osobola okutereka buli ssente bwe ziyingira. Kuuma ez'amangu mu kifo ekikuumibwa naye ky'osobola okutuukako, era zikozese ku bisaasaanyizo ebikulu ebitalindiriddwa byokka.
responses.sw: Kwa mwezi mmoja, andika mapato na matumizi yote. Anza na chakula, makazi, afya, usafiri na malipo ya madeni. Chagua kiasi kidogo cha akiba unachoweza kumudu na ukitenge kila mapato yanapoingia. Weka akiba ya dharura mahali salama lakini panapofikika, na uitumie tu kwa gharama muhimu zisizotarajiwa.
responses.nyn: Okwezi kumwe, handika esente zoona ezi orikutunga n'ezi orikushashura. Banza eby'okurya, enju, amagara, engyendo n'amabanja. Toorana omuhendo mukye ogu orikubaasa kutereka kandi ogute aharubaju buri sente zaija. Gwokye esente z'amangu omu mwanya ogurinzire kwonka ogu orikubaasa kuhikaho.
responses.nyo: Kumara kwezi kumu, handika sente zoona ezi orukutunga n'ezi orukusasura. Banza ebyokulya, enju, bwomeezi, engendo n'amabanja. Komamu omuhendo mutaito ogu osobora kutereka kandi ogute ha rubaju buli sente obuziraija. Linda sente ez'amangu omu kiikaro ekirinzire baitu eky'osobora kuhikaho.
responses.ach: Pi dwe acel, co lim ducu ma bino ki ma iwoto. Cak ki cam, gang, yotkom, wot ki culo bany. Yer lim manok ma iromo gwoko ka iketo tenge ka lim obino. Gwok lim me cawa me peko i kabedo ma ber ento iromo nongo, ki itii kwede pi jami mapire tek ma pe oneno anyim keken.
responses.teo: Kotoma elap yen, camun isirigin kere lu ibuni ka lu iponi. Ageun ka akimuj, akai, ajar, ainapakin ka akop. Seun isirigin lu idis lu ipedori akoru ido itek kes ace sek isirigin ibunete. Korau isirigin luka apedor toma apedor na ejok konye na ipedori ainakin.

responses.en: Never share your PIN, including with an agent or customer-care caller. Before confirming, read the recipient name and amount yourself. Ignore messages claiming you won a prize or must reverse money by sending it elsewhere. If you suspect fraud, stop the transaction, change your PIN and call the provider using its official number.
responses.lg: Togabana PIN yo na muntu yenna, wadde agenti oba akukubidde nga customer care. Nga tonnakakasa, soma erinnya ly'afuna n'omuwendo ggwe kennyini. Tokkiriza bubaka obugamba nti owangudde oba nti zzaayo ensimbi ng'ozisindika awalala. Bw'otekebereza obubbi, komya, kyusa PIN era kubira kampuni ku nnamba yaayo entongole.
responses.sw: Usimpe mtu yeyote namba yako ya siri, hata wakala au anayepiga akidai ni huduma kwa wateja. Kabla ya kuthibitisha, soma mwenyewe jina la mpokeaji na kiasi. Puuza ujumbe unaodai umeshinda zawadi au lazima urudishe pesa kwa kuzituma kwingine. Ukihisi utapeli, simamisha muamala, badili namba ya siri na piga namba rasmi ya mtoa huduma.
responses.nyn: Otaha PIN yaawe omuntu weena, nangwa agenti nari orikukweta naagira ngu ni customer care. Otakahamize, shoma iziina ry'orikwakira n'omuhendo iwe wenka. Otaikiriza obutumwa oburikugira ngu waasingura ekiconco nari ngu garura esente orikuzituma ahandi. Waateekateeka obushuma, rekyera aho, hindura PIN kandi oyete kampuni aha namba yaayo entongore.
responses.nyo: Otagambira muntu wena PIN yaawe, n'obwakuba agenti rundi arukukweta naagira ngu ali customer care. Otakagumya, soma ibara ly'arukutunga n'omuhendo iwe wenka. Otaikiriza obutumwa oburukugamba ngu osingwire ekisembo rundi ngu garura sente n'ozituma handi. Obw'otekereza obunyagi, yemerra, hindura PIN kandi okwate kampuni ha namba yaayo entongole.
responses.ach: Pe imi PIN ni bot ngat mo, kadi latin tic me lim onyo ngat ma lwongi ni en customer care. Mapwod pe imoko, kwan nying ngat ma bino nongo ki wel lim keni. Kwer kwena ma waco ni iloyo mot onyo myero idwok lim kun icwalo i kabedo mukene. Ka itamo ni kuro tye, juk tic, lok PIN ki ilwong kampuni ki namba gi matir.
responses.teo: Mam ilosi PIN kon angolol, aitu epese lo mobile money arai yen iluongit bala customer care. Sek mam ikitam, isomai ekiror loka yen ijaanakin ka isirigin. Mam iriamun abarit na ebala ijo alosit apolou arai ibongori isirigin aibwo ace. Karai iomit akonye, kowor aswam, iyongotu PIN ido iluongit kampuni ka enamba keng lo ajenara.

source.title: FAO Good Agricultural Practices for Family Agriculture

en: how do I prepare my soil

responses.en: Choose a crop suited to your rainfall, soil, season and a market you can reach; ask the local agricultural extension worker before buying seed. Rotate crop families, add well-rotted compost and protect bare soil with mulch. Use clean, recommended seed and keep records so you can compare yield, costs and selling price.
responses.lg: Londa ekirime ekituukana n'enkuba, ettaka, sizoni n'akatale k'osobola okutuukako; buuza omulimisa w'ekitundu nga tonnagula nsigo. Kyusakyusa ebika by'ebirime, kozesa nnakavundira avunze obulungi era bikka ettaka n'ebisigalira. Kozesa ensigo ennungi ekakasiddwa era wandiika amakungula, ensaasaanya n'omuwendo.
responses.sw: Chagua zao linalofaa mvua, udongo, msimu na soko unaloweza kufikia; muulize afisa ugani wa eneo kabla ya kununua mbegu. Badilisha familia za mazao, ongeza mboji iliyooza vizuri na funika udongo kwa matandazo. Tumia mbegu safi iliyopendekezwa na weka kumbukumbu za mavuno, gharama na bei.
responses.nyn: Toorana ekihingwa ekirikuhika aha njura, eitaka, obwire n'akatale aku orikubaasa kuhikaho; buuza omuhabuzi w'eby'obuhingi otakagwire mbibo. Hindurana ebika by'ebihingwa, taamu orusa rw'ebihingwa oruhweire kandi shweka eitaka. Koresa embibo nungi erikuhaburwa kandi handika omwimbu, ensaasaanya n'omuhendo.
responses.nyo: Komamu ekihingwa ekirukuhika ha njura, itaka, kasumi n'akatale aku osobora kuhikaho; kaguza omuhabuzi w'ebyobulimi otakagura mbibo. Hindurana ebika by'ebihingwa, tamu orusa oruhumbire kurungi kandi swera itaka. Kozesa embibo nungi erukuhaburwa kandi handika omwimbu, ensaasaanya n'omuhendo.
responses.ach: Yer gin apita ma rwate ki kot, ngom, kare ki cuk ma iromo oo iye; peny latin tic me pur me kabedo ni mapwod pe iwilo kodi. Lok kit gin apita, ket yugi ma obale maber ki ium ngom ki lum. Tii ki kodi maber ma gicimo ki ico kacoke me nyak, wel jami ki wel me cato.
responses.teo: Seun ekito lo ejok ka akiru, akoru, apak ka aduka na ipedori angaren; ingisit ekapolon loka akoru sek mam igwelata ikito. Kitoro ikito, ikodi akimesek na abu ka idik akoru ka amana. Kojau ikito lu ejok lu ajenara ido icamun akis lu akoru, agwelan ka amusan.

en: how do I reduce post harvest loss

responses.en: Harvest at the correct maturity and avoid bruising or mixing produce with soil. Dry grain thoroughly on a clean raised sheet, not bare ground. Sort out damaged or mouldy produce, clean the store, and use dry sealed containers or recommended hermetic bags. Check regularly for moisture, insects and rodents.
responses.lg: Kungula ebirime nga bituuse era weewale okubinyiga oba okubitabulamu ettaka. Kaza empeke bulungi ku kintu ekiyonjo ekisitule, si ku ttaka. Ggyamu ebyonoonese oba ebiriko ekikuku, yonja etterekero era kozesa ebintu ebikalu ebisibika oba ensawo eziziyiza empewo. Kebera amazzi, ebiwuka n'emmese buli kiseera.
responses.sw: Vuna mazao yakikomaa na epuka kuyachubua au kuchanganya na udongo. Kausha nafaka vizuri juu ya turubai safi iliyoinuliwa, si ardhini. Ondoa vilivyoharibika au vyenye ukungu, safisha ghala na tumia vyombo vikavu vilivyofungwa au mifuko maalumu isiyopitisha hewa. Kagua unyevu, wadudu na panya mara kwa mara.
responses.nyn: Imbura ebihingwa byahika kandi oyetantare kubihutaaza nari kubitaburamu eitaka. Omisha embibo gye aha sheeti erikwera ehanikire, ti aha itaka. Ihamu ebihutaare nari ebirikurema obukoko, yonja ekibiikiro kandi koresa ebintu bikyeire ebisibirwe gye. Kebera amaizi, obukooko n'embeba obutoosha.
responses.nyo: Gesa ebihingwa byahika kandi wetantale kubihutaaza rundi kubitaburamu itaka. Omya empeke kurungi ha suuka enyonjo ehimbire, hatali ha itaka. Ihyamu ebihutaire rundi ebirukwata ekikuku, yonja ekiikaro kandi kozesa ebintu ebikalu ebisibirwe. Kebera amaizi, obukooko n'embeba buli kaire.
responses.ach: Kac gin apita ka oceke maber ki igeng noto onyo ruro ki ngom. Ot kal maber i karatac maleng ma gi malo, pe i ngom. Yer woko jami ma obale onyo ma tye ki two, ywe ot me gwoko ki itii ki jami ma otwo ma giloro maber. Rot pii, kwidi ki oywe kare ki kare.
responses.teo: Korau akoru ka ateran ido mam ibila arai itubur ka akoru. Tiecai akinyomit toma atapar na ejok na ejarit, mam toma akoru. Seun lu abu arai lu ejai ka akiro, ilot akai na akoru ido ikojau iboro lu etiete lu emonyakinit. Jenutu akipi, apis ka imisin sek kere.

responses.en: Build meals from varied local foods: vegetables and fruit, beans or peas, whole grains or staples, and a protein source such as eggs, fish, milk or lean meat when available. Use clean water, wash hands and cook food thoroughly. Limit heavily processed foods, sugary drinks and excess salt. Needs differ for children, pregnancy and illness, so consult a health worker when unsure.
responses.lg: Teekateeka emmere ey'ebika eby'enjawulo ebiriwo: enva n'ebibala, ebijanjaalo oba entangawuuzi, emmere y'empeke, n'ekizimba omubiri nga amagi, ebyennyanja, amata oba ennyama entono bw'ebaawo. Kozesa amazzi amayonjo, naaba engalo era fumba bulungi. Kendeeza emmere ekoleddwa ennyo, ebyokunywa ebirimu ssukaali n'omunnyo omungi. Buuza omusawo ku baana, olubuto oba obulwadde.
responses.sw: Tengeneza milo kwa vyakula mbalimbali vya eneo lako: mboga na matunda, maharagwe au mbaazi, nafaka au chakula kikuu, na protini kama mayai, samaki, maziwa au nyama isiyo na mafuta inapopatikana. Tumia maji safi, nawa mikono na pika vizuri. Punguza vyakula vilivyosindikwa sana, vinywaji vya sukari na chumvi nyingi. Muulize mhudumu wa afya kuhusu watoto, ujauzito au ugonjwa.
responses.nyn: Teekateeka eby'okurya by'emiringo mingi eby'omu kyanga: emboga n'ebijuma, ebihimba nari obushaza, embibo nari eky'okurya kikuru, n'ebyombeka omubiri nk'amagi, encwamba, amata nari enyama ntaito. Koresa amaizi marungi, naaba engaro kandi teeka gye. Kendeeza eby'okurya ebikozirwe munonga, eby'okunywa bya shukaari n'omunyu mwingi. Buuza omujanjabi aha baana, enda nari oburwaire.
responses.nyo: Tekaniza ebyokulya by'emiringo nyingi eby'omu kiikaro: emboga n'ebijuma, ebihimba rundi obushaza, empeke rundi ekyokulya ekikuru, n'ebyombeka omubiri nk'amagi, encwamba, amata rundi enyama ntaito. Kozesa amaizi amarungi, naaba emikono kandi fumba kurungi. Kendeeza ebyokulya ebikozerwe muno, ebyokunywa bya sukali n'omunyu mwingi. Kaguza omujanjabi ha baana, enda rundi oburwaire.
responses.ach: Yub cam ki jami mapatpat me kabedo ni: pot yat ki nyig yen, muranga onyo kal, ki gin ma gero kom calo tong, rec, cak onyo ringo manok ka tye. Tii ki pii maleng, lwok cingi ki ited cam maber. Juk cam ma giyubo matek, mat madik ki kado madwong. Peny latin tic me yotkom pi litino, ic ki two.
responses.teo: Los meal ka akimuj na epone ipu na ejai toma akwap: alele ka araun, akonye arai akobok, akinyomit ka na idukorit akuan bala akok, ikian, akile arai akuan na mam ejaasi aboten. Kojau akipi na ejok, ilot akanin ido iboil akimuj ejok. Ducu akimuj na ebilakina, akipi nu sukari ka akape na epol. Ingisit ekapolon loka ajar pi iduwe, akuj arai adeka.

responses.en: Seek urgent care now for heavy bleeding, severe abdominal pain, convulsions, fainting, severe headache with blurred vision, difficulty breathing, high fever, labour that is not progressing, or greatly reduced baby movement. Do not wait for the chat. Arrange transport to the nearest health facility and ask a trusted person to accompany you.
responses.lg: Funa obujjanjabi obw'amangu kati bw'oba ovaamu omusaayi mungi, olina obulumi obw'amaanyi mu lubuto, ensimbu, ozirika, omutwe omunene n'okulaba obufu, okukaluubirirwa okussa, omusujja omungi, okuzaala okutagenda mu maaso, oba omwana okukendeera ennyo okutambula. Tolinda chat. Genda ku ddwaliro erisinga okumpi n'omuntu gw'wesiga.
responses.sw: Tafuta huduma ya dharura sasa ikiwa unatokwa damu nyingi, una maumivu makali ya tumbo, degedege, kuzimia, maumivu makali ya kichwa na kuona ukungu, shida ya kupumua, homa kali, uchungu usioendelea, au mtoto kupungua sana kusogea. Usisubiri mazungumzo haya. Panga usafiri kwenda kituo cha afya kilicho karibu na uende na mtu unayemwamini.
responses.nyn: Shaba obujanjabi bw'amangu hati waaba noorugamu eshagama nyingi, nooshasha munonga omunda, nootengyera, noogwa ahansi, noorwara omutwe munonga n'okureeba kubi, nooremwa kwitsya, oine omushwija mwingi, okuzaara kutarikugyenda omumaisho, nari omwana yaareka kuhindahinda. Otarindira aha chat. Za aha irwariro eriri haihi n'omuntu ou orikwesiga.
responses.nyo: Saba obujanjabi bw'amangu hati obworaaba norugamu esagama nyingi, nooshasha muno omunda, nootengyera, noogwa hansi, noorwara omutwe muno n'okurora kubi, nooremwa kwikya, oine omuswija mwingi, kuzaara kutarukugenda omumaiso, rundi omwana alekere kuhindahinda. Otarindira ha chat. Genda ha irwaliro eriri haihi n'omuntu ow'orukwesiga.
responses.ach: Cit oyot i gang yat kombedi ka remo kato madwong, ic rem matek, kom tuku, ipoto piny, wi rem matek ki wang ma neno piny, yweyo tek, lyeto madwong, nywal pe mede, onyo latin i ic pe dong tye ka nyute. Pe ikur lok man. Yub gin me wot i gang yat macok ki icit ki ngat ma igeno.
responses.teo: Kori ajar na apedor kwape karai iwudori noi, idou noi, ikurere, ijaruni, iwelet noi ka akonye, iswama noi, ijai ka alibun na epol, adoun mam elosete, arai idwe mam emukunit. Mam igwel toma aimori na. Konyutu ainapakin alosit toma ajar na apiana ka itunganan lo ijenara.

en: how do I stay safe online
ach: ngat mo tye ka yela i intanet
teo: itunganan ejai ka alaran toma internet

responses.en: Use a long unique password and two-step verification. Never share passwords or one-time codes. If someone harasses or threatens you, do not engage: save screenshots, links and dates, then block and report the account. Tell someone you trust. If you fear physical harm, move to a safe place and contact local support or police.
responses.lg: Kozesa ekigambo ky'ekyama ekiwanvu era eky'enjawulo, n'okukakasa okw'emitendera ebiri. Togabana bigambo bya kyama oba koodi ez'omulundi gumu. Omuntu bw'akubonyaabonya oba okukutiisatiisa, tomuddamu: kuuma ebifaananyi bya screen, link n'ennaku, oluvannyuma omuzibe era omulope. Gamba omuntu gw'wesiga. Bw'otya akabi ku mubiri, genda mu kifo ekikuumibwa era tuukirira obuyambi oba poliisi.
responses.sw: Tumia nenosiri refu la kipekee na uthibitishaji wa hatua mbili. Usishiriki nenosiri au msimbo wa mara moja. Mtu akikunyanyasa au kukutishia, usibishane naye: hifadhi picha za skrini, viungo na tarehe, kisha mzuie na umripoti. Mwambie mtu unayemwamini. Ukihofia madhara ya mwili, nenda mahali salama na uwasiliane na msaada wa eneo au polisi.
responses.nyn: Koresa ekigambo ky'ekihama ekiwanvu kandi eky'omutaano, hamwe n'okuhamya kw'emitendera ebiri. Otaha muntu bigambo by'ekihama nari koodi z'omurundi gumwe. Omuntu yaakupiganisa nari yaakutiinisa, otamugarukamu: biika ebishushani bya screen, link n'ebiro, reero omuzibire kandi omurege. Gambira omuntu ou orikwesiga. Waatiina kuhutazibwa, za omu mwanya ogurinzire kandi oyete obuyambi nari poriisi.
responses.nyo: Kozesa ekigambo ky'ekihama ekiwanvu kandi eky'embaganiza, hamu n'okukigumya kw'emitendera ebiri. Otagabana bigambo by'ekihama rundi koodi z'omurundi gumu. Omuntu obw'akupiganiza rundi akutiinisa, otamugarukamu: biika ebisisani bya screen, link n'ebiro, hanyuma omuzibire kandi omurege. Gambira omuntu ow'orukwesiga. Obw'otiina kuhutazibwa, genda omu kiikaro ekirinzire kandi ragira obukonyezi rundi poliisi.
responses.ach: Tii ki mung me donyo mabor ma pat ki moko tic ki yore aryo. Pe imi mung onyo namba me cawa acel bot ngat mo. Ka ngat mo yeli onyo lwongi ki lworo, pe ilare: gwok cal me screen, link ki nino, ka igeng ki imiyo ngec pire. Wac bot ngat ma igeno. Ka ilworo bal me kom, cit i kabedo ma ber ki ilwong jo me kony onyo polisi.
responses.teo: Kojau ekisil lo alalau lo edidi ka aijen na akiro aarei. Mam ilosi ikisil arai enamba lo iponi kapakio. Karai itunganan elarito arai itionarito, mam ingarakinos: korau isirin luka screen, link ka akwarin, ido ikatakin ka ibala. Losi itunganan lo ijenara. Karai ijo akuri adoun na akuan, alosit toma apedor na ejok ido iluongit lukaingaren arai polisi.

en: how do I apply for a job
help me prepare for an interview
ach: ayubere nining pi peny me tic
teo: alosia biai pi aingiseta na aswam

responses.en: Read the vacancy carefully and apply only through a verified contact. Your CV should list your phone number, relevant skills, education and recent experience clearly; do not include PINs, passwords or unnecessary private details. Before an interview, practise explaining one example of a problem you solved. A genuine employer should not demand payment to give you a job.
responses.lg: Soma bulungi omulimu ogulangibwa era saba ng'oyita mu bantu abakakasiddwa bokka. CV erage ennamba yo, obukugu obwetaagisa, okusoma n'obumanyirivu obupya; towandiikamu PIN, bigambo bya kyama oba ebikwata ku bulamu bwo ebiteetaagisa. Nga tonnagenda mu kubuuzibwa, gezaako okunnyonnyola ekizibu kye wagonjoola. Omukozesa omutuufu tasaba ssente kukuwa mulimu.
responses.sw: Soma tangazo la kazi kwa makini na utume ombi kupitia mawasiliano yaliyothibitishwa tu. Wasifu wako uonyeshe namba ya simu, ujuzi unaohusika, elimu na uzoefu wa karibuni; usiweke namba za siri, nenosiri au taarifa binafsi zisizohitajika. Kabla ya usaili, jizoeze kueleza tatizo moja ulilotatua. Mwajiri halali hataki malipo ili akupe kazi.
responses.nyn: Shoma gye orurango rw'omurimo kandi shaba orikurabira aha bantu abahamirwe bonka. CV yaawe eyorekye namba ya simu, obukugu oburikwetengwa, amashomo n'obumanyirizi; otataamu PIN, bigambo by'ekihama nari amakuru g'ekihama agatarikwetengwa. Otagire omu kubuuzibwa, yeega kugamba aha kizibu eki waamaraho. Omukozesa w'amazima takushaba sente kukuha omurimo.
responses.nyo: Soma kurungi orurango rw'omulimo kandi saba norabira hali abantu abakakasibwe bonka. CV yaawe eyoleke namba ya simu, obukugu oburukwetaagwa, amasomo n'obumanyirivu; otatamu PIN, bigambo by'ekihama rundi amakuru agatarukwetaagwa. Otakaire omu kukaguzibwa, yega kubaza ha kizibu eki wamalireho. Omukozesa w'amazima takusaba sente kukuha omulimo.
responses.ach: Kwan ngec me tic maber ki ikwa kun itiyo ki jo ma gimoko keken. CV ni omyero onyut namba me cim, ngec me tic, pwony ki tic ma itiyo; pe iket PIN, mung onyo ngec me keni ma pe mitte. Mapwod pe icito i peny, pwony lok i kom peko acel ma iyubo. Rwot tic matir pe okwanyo lim me mini tic.
responses.teo: Somai aisisianakin na aswam ejok ido iswama kotoma aiboisit na ajenara bon. CV kon konyutu enamba loka esimu, aijen na aswam, aisisia ka aswam na iswama; mam itau PIN, ikisila arai akiro kon nu mam ekot. Sek mam ilosi toma aingiseta, ijaasi alosikin apedor na ijo iswama. Ekapolon loka aswam lo ajenara mam ingisit isirigin pi ainakin aswam.

source.title: WHO Doing What Matters in Times of Stress

responses.en: Pause and take several slow breaths, noticing your feet on the ground and what you can see and hear. Choose one small useful action for today, and speak with someone you trust instead of carrying everything alone. If you may harm yourself or someone else, move away from dangerous items and seek urgent help from local emergency services, a health facility or a trusted person now.
responses.lg: Yimiriramu era ssa omukka mpola emirundi egiwerako, wuliriza ebigere byo ku ttaka n'ebyo by'olaba era by'owulira. Londa ekintu kimu ekitono eky'omugaso ky'osobola okukola leero, era yogera n'omuntu gw'wesiga. Bw'oba oyinza okwekolako oba okukola omulala akabi, va ku bintu eby'akabi era funa obuyambi kati ku ddwaliro, mu b'obuyambi oba eri omuntu gw'wesiga.
responses.sw: Simama kidogo na uvute pumzi polepole mara kadhaa, ukitambua miguu yako ardhini na unachokiona na kusikia. Chagua hatua moja ndogo yenye manufaa kwa leo, na zungumza na mtu unayemwamini badala ya kubeba yote peke yako. Ikiwa unaweza kujidhuru au kumdhuru mwingine, jiepushe na vitu hatari na utafute msaada wa haraka kutoka huduma za dharura, kituo cha afya au mtu unayemwamini sasa.
responses.nyn: Yemerera kakye kandi otsye mpora emirundi mingi, noohurira ebigyere byawe aha itaka n'ebi orikureeba kandi orikuhurira. Toorana ekikorwa kimwe kikye eky'omugasho eki orikubaasa kukora eri izooba, kandi gamba n'omuntu ou orikwesiga. Waaba noobaasa kwehutaaza nari kuhutaaza ondiijo, ruga aha bintu by'akabi kandi shaba obuyambi bw'amangu aha irwariro nari aha muntu ou orikwesiga.
responses.nyo: Yemerra kake kandi oikye mpora emirundi nyingi, noohurra ebigere byawe ha itaka n'ebi orukurora kandi orukuhurra. Komamu ekikorwa kimu kitaito eky'omugaso eki osobora kukora hati, kandi baza n'omuntu ow'orukwesiga. Obworaaba nosobora kwehutaaza rundi kuhutaaza ondi, ruga ha bintu by'akabi kandi saba obukonyezi bw'amangu ha irwaliro rundi hali omuntu ow'orukwesiga.
responses.ach: Juk manok ki iywe mot tyen mapol, kun inge tyeni i ngom ki jami ma ineno ki ma iwinyo. Yer tic acel matidi ma konyo ma iromo tiyo tin, ki ilok ki ngat ma igeno. Ka iromo balo komi onyo ngat mukene, aa woko ki i kin jami me bal ki inong kony oyot ki jo me kony, gang yat onyo ngat ma igeno kombedi.
responses.teo: Kowor idis ido iswama noi kapakio, ijen akonye kon toma akoru ka iboro lu iyongarit. Seun aswam yen na edit na ejok na ipedori aswam lolo, ido ilosi itunganan lo ijenara. Karai ipedori abila ijo arai ace, aiwun ka iboro luka apedor ido ijeni ngarak na apedor toma ajar arai itunganan lo ijenara kotoma apak na.
